title: Black Friday Deal = How Many Hours of Work? #shorts
description:
Guess first: how many hours of work are 120 € sneakers? Comment a number.

At Germany's 2026 minimum wage of 13.90 € gross an hour, a 120 € Black Friday deal costs almost 9 hours of work. Divide the price by your pay per hour before you buy. Example prices; tax and deductions not included.

Sources: Bundesregierung (Mindestlohn 2026), Deutsche Rentenversicherung (Minijob 2026)

Not financial advice.
